SCHEDULE J

MALE ATHLETIC COACHES

The annual salary of the following male athletic coaches shall be increased above the salary guide—based on the first step in Schedule A of the current salary guide—as follows:

<table border="1"><tr><td>Football</td><td>16%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>8%</td><td>Assistants</td></tr><tr><td>Basketball</td><td>16%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>8%</td><td>1st Assistant</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>7.4%</td><td>2nd Assistant</td></tr><tr><td>Baseball</td><td>11.5%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>5.5%</td><td>Assistants</td></tr><tr><td>Cross Country</td><td>4%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>2%</td><td>Assistants</td></tr><tr><td>Indoor Track</td><td>5%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>3%</td><td>Assistants</td></tr><tr><td>Spring Track</td><td>8%</td><td>Head Coach</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>4%</td><td>Assistants</td></tr><tr><td>Gymnastics</td><td>8%</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Swimming</td><td>7.4%</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Fencing</td><td>5%</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Bowling</td><td>5%</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Tennis</td><td>5%</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Faculty Advisor</td><td>16%</td><td></td></tr></table>

Coaches shall receive an extended service increment of $100 after five (5) years of service; a second $100 extended-service increment after ten (10) years; and a third $100 extended-service increment after twenty (20) years.
